proposal.reason: Primary change is communicator configuration control: new config fields are validated/defaulted, overridden from env, stored on comm state, and synchronized across ranks (init.cc, comm.h). device-topology is independently substantive because P2P channel-per-peer computation now uses nChannelsPerNetPeer/maxP2pPeers policy in topology-based channel sizing (graph/paths.cc). enqueue is independently substantive because graphUsageMode now changes stream/graph-capture handling and P2P planning behavior during runtime enqueue/strongstream operations, beyond mechanical call-site updates.
